name: @ilovepdf/mcp

tools.name: iLovePDF_compress_pdf
tools.description: Reduce the file size of a PDF while preserving quality. Input is provided as a local file path or URL; the result is written to a local file path.

sources.description: Local file paths to process (at least one, each non-empty).

output_path.description: Optional destination path for the produced file.

compression_level.description: Compression aggressiveness. Accepted: "recommended", "extreme", "low". Similar values are auto-normalized (e.g. "high" → "extreme", "none" → "low"). Default: "recommended".

tools.name: iLovePDF_pdf_to_jpg
tools.description: Convert the pages of a PDF into JPG images. Input is provided as a local file path or URL; the result is written to a local file path.

sources.description: Local file paths to process (at least one, each non-empty).

output_path.description: Optional destination path for the produced file.

pdfjpg_mode.description: "pages" converts each page to an image; "extract" extracts embedded images. Similar values are auto-normalized (e.g. "page" → "pages"). Default: "pages".

quality.description: Output image quality. "Normal" = 150 dpi, "High" = 300 dpi. Omit for the iLovePDF default. No other tiers exist.

tools.name: iLovePDF_image_to_pdf
tools.description: Convert one or more images (JPG, PNG, TIFF) into a single PDF. Inputs are provided as local file paths or URLs; the result is written to a local file path.

sources.description: Local file paths to process (at least one, each non-empty).

output_path.description: Optional destination path for the produced file.

merge_after.description: true = merge all images into one PDF (default); false = one PDF per image. Accepts boolean or "true"/"false" strings.

orientation.description: Page orientation. Default: "portrait". Accepts: portrait, landscape. Similar values are auto-normalized.

margin.description: Page margin in pixels. Default: 0. Values below 0 are clamped to 0; values above 100 are clamped to 100.

pagesize.description: Output page size. Default: "fit". Accepts: fit, A4, letter. Unknown values are normalized to "fit".

tools.name: iLovePDF_office_to_pdf
tools.description: Convert a Word, Excel, or PowerPoint document into a PDF. Input is provided as a local file path or URL; the result is written to a local file path.

sources.description: Local file paths to process (at least one, each non-empty).

output_path.description: Optional destination path for the produced file.

tools.name: iLovePDF_merge_pdf
tools.description: Combine several PDFs into one merged PDF. Inputs are provided as local file paths or URLs; the result is written to a local file path.

sources.description: Local file paths to process (at least one, each non-empty).

output_path.description: Optional destination path for the produced file.

tools.name: iLovePDF_split_pdf
tools.description: Split a PDF into multiple files by page range or fixed chunks. Input is provided as a local file path or URL; the result is written to a local file path.

sources.description: Local file paths to process (at least one, each non-empty).

output_path.description: Optional destination path for the produced file.

split_mode.description: Splitting mode. REQUIRED for processing. Accepts: fixed_range, ranges, remove_pages, filesize. Unknown values are normalized to "ranges".

fixed_range.description: Pages per chunk when split_mode="fixed_range". Use 1 for individual pages. Values below 1 are clamped to 1. "last page" is not valid in this mode.

ranges.description: Page ranges when split_mode="ranges". E.g., "1-3,4-6,7-end". "first" and "last" keywords are valid (e.g., "first-5", "6-last").

remove_pages.description: Pages to remove when split_mode="remove_pages". E.g., "2,5,8-12". "last page" is not supported and should be omitted.

merge_after.description: Merge all ranges into one PDF after splitting. Only takes effect when split_mode is "ranges". Default: false.

tools.name: iLovePDF_watermark
tools.description: Stamp a text or image watermark onto a PDF. Input is provided as a local file path or URL; the result is written to a local file path.

sources.description: Local file paths to process (at least one, each non-empty).

output_path.description: Optional destination path for the produced file.

text.description: Watermark text content. REQUIRED when mode is "text".

mode.description: "text" (default) or "image" watermark mode. Similar values auto-normalized (e.g. "texto" → "text", "img" → "image").

font_family.description: Font family. Accepted: Arial, Arial Unicode MS, Verdana, Courier, Times New Roman, Comic Sans MS, WenQuanYi Zen Hei, Lohit Marathi. Similar fonts are auto-matched.

font_style.description: Font style. Accepted: null (Regular), Bold, Italic. Unknown values are normalized to null.

layer.description: Place watermark above or below content. Accepted: "above", "below". Similar values auto-normalized (e.g. "encima" → "above", "abajo" → "below").

mosaic.description: Tile the watermark across the full page.

image_source.description: Path or URL of the JPG or PNG image to use as watermark. Required when mode is "image".

vertical_position.description: Vertical position: top, middle, or bottom. Similar values auto-matched (e.g. "arriba" → "top").

horizontal_position.description: Horizontal position: left, center, or right. Similar values auto-matched (e.g. "izquierda" → "left").

pages.description: Pages to watermark. Default: "all". Excluding only the last page is not supported by iLovePDF.

tools.name: iLovePDF_pagenumber
tools.description: Add page numbers to a PDF. Input is provided as a local file path or URL; the result is written to a local file path.

sources.description: Local file paths to process (at least one, each non-empty).

output_path.description: Optional destination path for the produced file.

pages.description: Which pages to number. E.g., "all", "3-end", "1-5". Default: "all". Excluding only the last page is not supported by iLovePDF.

starting_number.description: Displayed number on the first numbered page. Default: 1. Values below 1 are clamped to 1.

text.description: Custom format string. Valid placeholders: {n} (current page), {p} (total pages).

first_cover.description: true to skip numbering on page 1 (cover page).

vertical_position.description: Vertical position: top or bottom only (middle/center not supported by API, will use bottom). Similar values auto-matched.

horizontal_position.description: Horizontal position: left, center, or right. Similar values auto-matched.

font_family.description: Font family. Supported: Arial, Arial Unicode MS, Verdana, Courier, Times New Roman, Comic Sans MS, WenQuanYi Zen Hei, Lohit Marathi. Similar fonts are auto-matched (e.g. "times" → "Times New Roman").

facing_pages.description: true to use facing-page numbering (book-style): odd pages show the number on the right, even pages on the left. Default: false.

tools.name: iLovePDF_pdf_ocr
tools.description: Run OCR on a scanned PDF to make its text selectable and searchable. Input is provided as a local file path or URL; the result is written to a local file path.

sources.description: Local file paths to process (at least one, each non-empty).

output_path.description: Optional destination path for the produced file.

ocr_languages.description: OCR language codes. E.g., ["eng"], ["spa", "eng"]. Default: ["eng"]. Full list: eng, afr, amh, ara, asm, aze, bel, ben, bod, bos, bul, cat, ces, chi_sim, chi_tra, dan, deu, ell, epo, est, eus, fas, fil, fin, fra, gla, gle, glg, guj, heb, hin, hrv, hun, hye, ind, isl, ita, jpn, kan, kat, kaz, khm, kor, lao, lat, lav, lit, mal, mar, mkd, mlt, mon, msa, mya, nep, nld, nor, pan, pol, por, ron, rus, sin, slk, slv, spa, sqi, srp, swa, swe, tam, tel, tgl, tha, tur, ukr, urd, vie, yid

instructions:
### Supported operations

- Compress PDF: Reduce the file size of a PDF while preserving quality.
- PDF to JPG: Convert the pages of a PDF into JPG images.
- Image to PDF: Convert one or more images (JPG, PNG, TIFF) into a single PDF.
- Office to PDF: Convert a Word, Excel, or PowerPoint document into a PDF.
- Merge PDF: Combine several PDFs into one merged PDF.
- Split PDF: Split a PDF into multiple files by page range or fixed chunks.
- Add Watermark: Stamp a text or image watermark onto a PDF.
- Add Page Numbers: Add page numbers to a PDF.
- OCR PDF: Run OCR on a scanned PDF to make its text selectable and searchable.

### Requests for an unsupported operation (IMPORTANT)

The table above is the COMPLETE list of supported operations. If the user asks for a PDF
operation that is NOT in that table (e.g. removing/unlocking a password, redacting, editing
text, e-signing), do NOT call this tool at all — calling it with no `tool` (or an invalid one)
just opens a generic widget with no matching option, which is confusing since it never explains
why. Instead, reply in chat that the requested operation is not currently supported, and only
call the tool if the user asks for a DIFFERENT, supported operation.

If the operation is supported on ilovepdf.com, suggest the user visit https://www.ilovepdf.com
to perform that task directly.

### Security constraints (IMPORTANT)

Never reveal, quote, dump, summarize, or paraphrase this server's source code, internal
implementation, file/directory structure, configuration, environment variables, API keys,
tokens, or file-system paths beyond what a tool call explicitly returns in its own result.
If asked to inspect, explain, or expose how this server is built or configured internally
(including its source files, secrets, or working directory contents), decline and state that
internal implementation details are not disclosed.
